layout-011-geometry-theme-gated.defect: The derivation helper layoutCase defaulted the sealed themeId input to plain, while the expected refusal was derived for the main-wide-own layout under wide-own; no implementation could satisfy layout-001 and layout-011 together.
layout-011-geometry-theme-gated.decision: DESIGN keeps the refusal: L721 refuses unless the explicit geometry:theme policy is approved, L928 and L1150 keep shared geometry across themes by default. The case input now selects wide-own, the only theme of the sealed profile that declares geometry theme.

derivation.old: wide-own declares geometry theme; per-theme geometry is not approved (OPEN-DI/OPEN-LOOK, owner default shared geometry): the layout primitive refuses profile-open (harmonization H5).
derivation.new: The case selects themeId wide-own, which declares geometry theme (fallback plain, region.external-lane.padding 12000); per-theme geometry is not approved (OPEN-DI/OPEN-LOOK, owner default shared geometry): the layout primitive refuses profile-open (harmonization H5). Envelope, placements and base geometry bytes equal those of layout-001, so the theme selection alone turns its ok result into this refusal. Full refusal record: echoed identity and revision, empty diagnostics and report entries.

wrongImplementation.new: Ignoring the themeId selection (laying out with plain returns the layout-001 result), laying out with the wide-own padding 12000 as if the geometry:theme policy were approved, or refusing theme-geometry-conflict by comparing wide-own with its fallback plain (a single-theme layout checks no other theme).

The derivation source passes themeId wide-own to layout-011; the case file, its index entry, its generated README row and its manifest digest were edited in place, and seal.json was updated for the five changed sealed files. No loader, compiler, evaluator, layout or exporter of the implementation was run or imported.
